title: seed-sprint-mini-ledger-mika
content:
Purpose: lightweight personal ledger to track a short seed sprint of quantization/batching micro-experiments. Not for publication — quick notes, rough stats, reproductions.

Summary: Ran 6 variants across two models (gpt-small-v1, gpt-mid-v1) to get p50 latency and rough cost per 1k tokens. Small sample sizes (20 requests each) — use as directional signal only.

Table (CSV-like):
exp_id, date, model, quant, batch_size, input_tokens(avg), p50_ms, p95_ms, cost_per_1k_tokens(USD), notes, status
EXP-2024-03-A, 2024-03-22, gpt-small-v1, fp16, 1, 64, 32, 78, 0.015, baseline single-token streaming, complete
EXP-2024-03-B, 2024-03-22, gpt-small-v1, int8, 1, 64, 26, 62, 0.010, int8 reduces p50 ~20%, check output delta on 10 prompts, complete
EXP-2024-03-C, 2024-03-23, gpt-small-v1, int8, 4, 64, 74, 140, 0.004, batching x4 increases p50 but lowers unit cost, ugly tail, in_review
EXP-2024-03-D, 2024-03-24, gpt-mid-v1, fp16, 1, 120, 58, 120, 0.028, stronger model baseline, cost jump noticeable, draft
EXP-2024-03-E, 2024-03-24, gpt-mid-v1, q4_k, 1, 120, 40, 92, 0.019, q4_k looks promising (quality spot-check minimal), draft
EXP-2024-03-F, 2024-03-25, gpt-mid-v1, q4_k, 8, 120, 190, 420, 0.005, high batching hurts latency but cost/unit tiny, TODO: measure cold starts

Quick observations:
- int8 on small model gave the best latency win with minimal visible quality drift on my prompt set (10/10 spot checks).
- q4_k on mid model is good for cost but latency becomes problematic for interactive usage; consider hybrid routing.
- Batching reduces cost per token dramatically but spikes p95; need to track distribution of request sizes to set safe batch windows.

Repro steps (local runtime CLI snippet):
# example: run a micro-bench for EXP-2024-03-B
redwood bench run \
  --model gpt-small-v1 \
  --quant int8 \
  --batch 1 \
  --seq-len 64 \
  --requests 20 \
  --output bench/exp-2024-03-B.json

Notes to self / next actions:
- Run a 100-request sweep for the top 3 promising variants (EXP-B, EXP-E, EXP-F) with stable prompt set. Capture token breakdowns. (owner: Mika)
- Add a small eval script to compute BLEU/bert-score on the 10 gold prompts used for spot checks (owner: Ravi).
- Slack @Noelle for infra check on cold-start variance; include container warmup suggestion.

Loose timeline: try to have the 100-request follow-ups done by 2024-04-08.

Random scratch lines:
- observed a GPU mem spike on EXP-F at batch 8 -> check KV cache handling
- 0.019 USD/1k tokens estimate for q4_k mid-model seems optimistic vs dedicated pricing; sanity-check with ops pricing doc

Short log of changes:

2024-03-22 ran small-model experiments (A,B,C)
2024-03-24 added mid-model variants (D,E)
2024-03-25 quick batch run (F) and noted cold-start TODO

End of mini-ledger.
